name: WNBA_R3B0_H2H_SUPPORT_CUSTODY_CONTRACT_V1
purpose: Close the historical support window needed to construct the preregistered two-season H2H and strict-prefix R3 features for the 2020-2025 development years without backward substitution or post-outcome cohort changes.

h2h_semantics.lookback: Target-season meetings strictly before target date plus immediately preceding season meetings; no game on target date and no future game.
h2h_semantics.later_years: Previous season plus strict prior-date target-season meetings.

audit_requirements: Download every asset by exact release asset_id and independently match exact byte size and SHA-256.
Inspect 2019 and 2020 season_type values and regular-season two-sided game identity without assuming modern special-event structure.
Join every candidate 2020 regular-season target game to the frozen schedule master by canonical game_id and verify home/away identity.
Verify all R3A required Four Factors and shot-profile stat fields exist and are valid on 2019 and 2020 two-sided regular rows.
Verify schedule chronology can support strict target-date batching.
Do not select/exclude 2020 games based on winner, score margin, model probability, accuracy or sportsbook information.
pass_rule: 2019 support and 2020 target/support advance only if exact asset custody, two-sided regular identity, schedule chronology/join and required feature coverage all pass without outcome-based exclusions.
fail_rule: If 2020 target custody fails, 2020 cannot silently remain in performance evaluation; the failure must be frozen as a custody limitation before any R3 combination scoring.
